description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git blame' with various ignore revision options, including setting up repository states, executing blame commands with different parameters, and verifying the outputs against expectations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success with a setup command.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for validation.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Creates a new commit or checkpoint for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message.
